A small release: FastQC on the reads as they arrive, and a security fix in a transitive dependency.

- **New `--fastqc_raw` runs the bundled FastQC on the input, before trimming** ([#576](https://github.com/FelixKrueger/TrimGalore/pull/576)) — reports are written as `*_raw_fastqc.html`/`.zip` and carry the `_raw` marker inside the report itself, so MultiQC reads them as separate samples from the trimmed set with no pipeline-side configuration.
- **`rustix` moves to 1.1.6, clearing RUSTSEC-2026-0486** ([#575](https://github.com/FelixKrueger/TrimGalore/pull/575)) — a transitive dependency; no behaviour change.

Full record, including every dependency bump:
[CHANGELOG, Version 2.6.0](https://www.trimgalore.com/reference/changelog/#version-260-release-on-19-november-2026).

## Install

```bash
cargo install trim-galore
conda install -c bioconda trim-galore
docker pull ghcr.io/felixkrueger/trimgalore:latest
```
